items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: take these scores over to Tom's to get them copied

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. That's very true, because there was one time I was doing some things with Johnny Hodges, you know, with a small group, about eight or ten pieces, and Tom Whaley -- Duke was living next door to me, and Tom Whaley was living about, oh, maybe three blocks away, and Billy Strayhorn. We were all living in one area. So I had to

take these scores over to Tom's to get them copied, and Tom says, "Take a look at this. This is one of Duke's scores." And I looked at it, and I said, "Tom, this can't work." He said, "You've been listening to it for the last 25 years."
